title: Live audio mixing
changes: Simplified the recording player to a single Edit action with the close button kept at the top right.
Audio source sliders and mute controls now update playback immediately without modifying the clip until Save is pressed.

title: Dedicated clip editor
changes: Replaced the player Edit menu with direct Trim and Audio actions.
Added a dedicated editor workspace with a large video preview and persistent Mix and Trim sidebar tabs.

title: Editing inside the player
changes: Moved Trim and Volume mix out of clip-card menus and into the recording player.
Playback now stays visible while adjusting individual audio source tracks.

title: True multi-track audio
changes: New recordings and replays now keep application and microphone audio on named, independently editable tracks.
Volume mixing rebuilds the default playback mix while preserving the source tracks and original video quality.

title: Clip volume mixer
changes: Added per-track volume and mute controls with options to update a clip or save a new mixed copy.
Moved clip editing actions into a compact three-dot menu.

title: Stable update checks
changes: Manual update checks are now available on both stable and nightly channels.

title: Startup reliability and changelog
changes: Stopped transient process-list output from surfacing as a startup error.
Added this scrolling release history to the About page.
Consolidated updates and telemetry behind clips.jss.fi.

title: First stable release
changes: Introduced separate stable and nightly update channels.
Raw recording thumbnails now skip the black frames before game capture appears.
Added optional anonymous version or diagnostic telemetry.
Bundled complete third-party licensing notices and source information.

title: Development releases
changes: Built the native libobs recording and replay-buffer engine.
Added per-application audio, MPV playback, trimming, storage cleanup, and restart-only updates.
Redesigned the recording library, settings, tray controls, and in-game notifications.
